input_fields.name: face_reference
input_fields.description: One current face whose underlying geometry type is to be classified.

input_fields.name: type_criterion
input_fields.description: Allowed analytic type set and classification rule.

result_fields.name: face_type
result_fields.description: One analytic type or unknown; freeform is not forced into an analytic class.

procedure: Read the face's underlying geometry type once.
Compare it with type_criterion and return one type label or unknown.
Record the source geometry type and classification_status.
Do not fit a freeform surface to a cylinder/cone/torus to force a label.
rejection_rules: Reject inaccessible geometry, undefined labels, or a criterion that asks for multiple classifications.
Reject visual resemblance as a substitute for underlying type.
Do not modify the face to obtain a recognized type.
